decisions.subject: Product design pivot: flavor vector space + cosine matching
decisions.decision: ADOPT docs/product/FLAVOR_VECTOR_DESIGN_V1.md. 8-dimension SCA/WCR-style flavor vector; V_pred from a physics/knowledge matrix over C0-C2 (brew, roast, variety+processing); V_user from Q5-Q10 with fixed increments; cosine similarity, bias vector dV, V_target = V_pred + a*dV; candidate library by cosine; attribution text. No training, no transformer; MLP only as an optional V_pred implementation, not planned. ARCHIVE the adaptive-question / proposition-lattice / product-inference v0-v0.2 line (docs/archive/adaptive-question-policy-20260912). CR-2 APPROVED. F19 repair APPROVED. New tables unified on the current checkpoint (83K after CR-2).

decisions.subject: Vector design: dimension count, candidate-library path, structure axes
decisions.decision: (1) 12 dimensions: the 8 SCA/WCR axes plus spice, herbal_green, woody_earthy, defect — 94/94 canonical concepts covered; defect is the negative constraint. (2) Candidate library = flavor profiles first (Target Profile Vector), then owner-named benchmark beans (classic templates such as Gesha / Kenya AA), then a user/community-entered offline library; product positioned as a scientific sensory diagnosis and flavor exploration tool, not a shopping guide; CoffeeReview coffees are never recommended items. (3) CoffeeReview Body and Acidity 1-10 editorial scores approved as the body / acidity axes (rank percentile).

decisions.subject: Coherence decision tree, 8-pick-5 implicit feedback, Q6 escalation gate, consumer lexicon; anchor-17 and statements confirmed
decisions.decision: (1) anchor-17 confirmed as 蜂蜜甜果与杏桃 / Honeyed Sweet Fruit & Apricot, owner_reviewed=true; anchor-08 stays in the anchor table. (2) 27 context statements approved; displayTags two-level algorithm and defect >= 0.5 guard confirmed. (3) 94 canonical concepts are sufficient as the algebraic base; the consumer-facing layer must be expanded with mainland-China e-commerce / social vocabulary (supplement matrix: floral 桂花/栀子花/咖啡花/白兰花/洋甘菊; fruity 巨峰葡萄/荔枝/杨梅/西梅/青梅/红心芭乐; sweetness 冰糖雪梨/太妃糖/麦芽糖/黑糖/罗汉果甜; herbal_green 高山龙井/武夷岩茶/鸭屎香/普洱茶韵; fermented 米酒/酒酿/酒酿圆子/黄酒/热带水果发酵酱; bitter_roasted 烤杏仁/烘焙麦芽/黑芝麻/松露巧克力) in Step 5. (4) Question flow = coherence decision tree: base Q0-Q1, check Q2-Q3, Paths 1-4, thresholds Sim >= 0.85 coherent / 0.65-0.85 mild / < 0.65 severe; first description 3+5 words with 'pick the 5 that fit' as implicit feedback; escalation gate renders Q6 (8-word checkbox) only when the flow saw severe conflict and the picks confirm the perception bias; otherwise the final card (the user's 5 words + 1-2 science lines + closing).

decisions.subject: Coherence thresholds 0.80 / 0.65; slot mapping approved; lexicon v1 locked; alpha_strong and branch-A card confirmed
decisions.decision: Thresholds: coherent >= 0.80, severe < 0.65 (mild between). Rationale: the product's users want precision and participation, not speed; ~30% highly consistent users take Path 1, ~60% experience a corrective Path 2 (perceived expertise), ~10% trigger strong correction. Slot mapping approved (Q0 acid, Q1 aroma; Q2 sweetness, Q3 body; Q4 bitterness, Q5 complexity). CN_CONSUMER_FLAVOR_LEXICON v1 (29 terms) locked as the first presentation base; Step 5 expands from GACTT and social corpora with emphasis on fermented_winey and local terms. alpha_strong = 0.9 confirmed; branch A shows the user's 5 picked words with evidence-tagged science lines and the thank-you line.

decisions.subject: 94 concept tags approved; literature claim conventions; three local test suites; hybrid utterance mapper; persona blueprints
decisions.decision: (1) All 94 concept-level minimalist tags approved (owner_reviewed=true) as the V1 canonical baseline lexicon. (2) Literature intake conventions: wcr_sensory_lexicon (C2_variety + C1_roast), uc_davis_coffee_center (C0_brew), coffee_ad_astra (C0_brew and C0_brew__C1_roast combinations). (3) Three local test suites: semantic disambiguation (20-30 consumer utterances -> Q0-Q5), persona full-path simulations (Persona A Path 1 / B Path 2 correction / C negation + Q6 when the vectors do not converge), consumer-lexicon naturalness. (4) Hybrid mapper: negation prefix scan, cosine for direction questions, cue hits for parallel questions, score = alpha*cosine + beta*cueHits, negation forcing (不苦 -> Q4-B, 不酸/怕酸 -> Q0-C). (5) Q0-Q5 wording must match Chinese coffee lovers' everyday language.

(4) Core content of the three claims files supplied by the owner (WCR -> C2_variety + C1_roast; UC Davis -> C0_brew; Coffee Ad Astra -> C0_brew and C0__C1 combinations). decisions.subject: Owner's copy review: positioning first, evidence labelling by kind, claim re-verification, exit options in the question bank, profile naming, About reading order
decisions.decision: flavorwords is positioned as a research-backed tool that helps enthusiasts recognise and describe the flavor in the cup: a few choices → a flavor card the reader confirms → reference notes with declared sources. Implementation vocabulary (diagnosis, attribution, calibration, bias, paradox, pruning, orthogonal, signature space) leaves the user copy. Evidence labels say what kind of statement it is (参考说明 / 资料统计 / 研究参考 / 描述差异); claims pending a locator or re-verification never reach the screen. ΔV is a difference, not a bias, and its cause is not asserted. Three literature claims held back after external checks (WCR lexicon cannot support a genotype ceiling; UC Davis fractionation contradicts 'acids first'); Coffee Ad Astra author corrected to Jonathan Gagné. Q0 options narrowed to one dimension, Q2 gets 'sweetness not noticeable', Q4 gets 'clearly bitter', Q5 loses its quality words; an absence answer caps the first coherence check at mild. Sixteen profiles renamed to two sensory references each; the defect group becomes 纸味与陈味 with a second-sip note and no quality verdict. About reordered: purpose → sample card → author and work → scope with units → visuals → how a card is made → technical notes → sources.
decisions.owner_words: 先让人理解这个产品值得用在哪里，再让人看到支撑它的研究 … 帮助我把这一杯咖啡的感受，说得更具体 … 不要让用户先读懂你的实现方式，才能理解产品价值 … 系统站在了判定用户感受对错的位置 … 每一句成因都注明出处 目前说得过满 … ΔV 不能直接叫作用户的感官偏置 … 以两个主要感官参照命名 … 产品用途 → 体验示例 → 作者与具体工作 → 资料来源 → 方法细节

decisions.subject: Copy review 2 + mobile pass: hard source errors fixed, project rules off the card, exits on every taste question, hero as home page, 54 dp controls, four-page scroll-driven About
decisions.decision: Sources: the UC Davis DOI (10.1016/j.foodchem.2020.126567) resolves to a turmeric-authentication paper, so all four UC Davis notes are withdrawn (review_state) and the source leaves the reader's list until re-established; the WCR licence is recorded as observed on the page (free personal-use copies, no CC BY-SA statement) with source terms and project use kept in separate fields; the owner's causal sentences are project rules that document how the initial reference is formed and never appear on the card. The card's fold ('关于这段描述') shows the initial reference (computed from V_pred, said once, with its one-line explanation), the first sourced research reference, and the difference line 'Compared with the initial reference profile, {feature} is more / less pronounced in your description'. The card's group name follows the confirmed words (V_target + picks). Question bank: Q1 gains 闻不出明显的香气, Q4 becomes intensity only (有一点苦 / 没有明显苦感 / 苦感明显, increments 1 / 0 / 2), any absence answer caps the first check at mild; processing offers the eight bag methods plus decaf (honey, semi-washed, wet-hulled, lactic, barrel-aged have no reference row yet and say so); origin chips show only the place name. Copy: hero title 'Put this cup into words' in both languages, tiles 开始 / 关于 replace the About icon, About opens with 从品饮，到表达 and the sample card, the author section follows the owner's draft, boundary statements sit once under 结果的适用范围, 83K / 待复核 / 不是质量保证 leave the user copy, English edited on its own (flavor spelling, About this description, 3 main suggestions and 5 alternatives). Mobile: 1 : 2 on the home page and 1 : 3 in the flow, every icon control 54 × 54, chips 48 +, options 60 +, question titles at the top, two-line context chips, GSAP springs for card transitions. About: four pages — purpose + sample, author + three folded entries, the provenance flow and the sixteen profiles each drawn by scroll in a 320 dvh track (GSAP ScrollTrigger on the sheet), then sources with terms and use.

decisions.subject: Copy review 3 + brand pass: the flavor card as the product object, home to the owner's proportions, poster-style About visuals, origins by continent, selection trace, serif proposals
decisions.decision: The flavor card is rebuilt as a three-layer object (the cup's own information with dotted leaders; the five confirmed words at equal weight under a violet selection trace; the reference entry and the flavorwords signature) on a cream card with a motif made of the words' feature colours, and it is shown on the home page as the main display object as well as in About and at the end of the flow — the group name no longer titles the card. The selection trace (violet underline) follows a chosen word from the quiz options and the picks to the card and the samples. Home follows the owner's stated proportions: hero 2.25 : 1 lower band, a smaller bold wordmark, 'Put this cup into words' bold, no status dot, two tall bright rectangular buttons (Start clay, About lime), the language badge a black rounded rectangle. About opens with 从品味，到表达, two intro sentences and a mission paragraph with real counts (8 panels, 83,031 descriptions, 4,042 consumers, roaster labels on Dianping / Xiaohongshu / Taobao); the author section is the owner's one-liner plus one sentence of work; the big numbers leave the headlines. The two visuals are rebuilt as full black pages drawn by scroll (420 dvh each): a column-and-trunk poster (A–L features on a log scale, stacked by panel, joining into the 8,142-record trunk, with a panel index and feature legend) after the extinction chart, and a numbered profile network (16 circles on two rings, curves to the two nearest groups, C1–C6 callouts with shared features, index and legend) after the spheres spread. Origin chips are the owner's chart: 19 countries grouped by continent, place names only, δ-0.1 nudges from the continent's usual tendencies. Seven OFL serif proposals for the wordmark delivered as a comparison page (Fraunces, Instrument Serif, Young Serif recommended).
